blocks.html:
This is documentation authoring platform for Axtroid Documentation Portal www.axtroid.com/documentation.
The DocStudio facilitates seamless integration to the live publishing on the portal with easy user interface.
Always make sure you have necessary access to work on DocStudio.
Before you start using DocStudio, user must download the stand-alone app.

items: Once the app is downloaded on to the desktop, click to open the app.
Make sure you see instructions page.
Follow the instructions to set the real-time authoring-environment.
Click ⚙️Settings icon on the top left.
Fill the details as shown below then click Save Settings.
Path: docs/index.html (obtain it from your admin)
Personal access token: (obtain it from you admin)

blocks.html: Application must be restarted to sync with the live content on the server.
